title: SAP BW Consultant
summary: Builds and runs the SAP BW data warehouse (BW/4HANA or BW on HANA) that pulls data out of SAP and other systems and turns it into reports for finance, sales and supply chain teams. Sits in an SAP analytics or data team, between business users, SAP functional consultants and ABAP developers.
dailyDuties: Model ADSOs and composite providers for new reports
Build extractors, transformations and DTPs to load source data
Monitor process chains and fix failed loads
Write ABAP routines to clean and derive fields
Build BEx queries and Analysis for Office workbooks
Meet business users to capture reporting requirements

skills.expectation: Model data in BW/4HANA or BW on HANA with ADSOs, composite providers and Open ODS views
Build data flows from SAP and non-SAP sources with extractors, ODP, transformations and DTPs
Schedule and monitor process chains and fix failed data loads
Build BEx queries and Analysis for Office workbooks for business users
Build native HANA calculation views and SQLScript where BW alone is not enough
Write ABAP in start, end and expert routines and custom extractors
Query and reconcile data between BW and source systems
Turn business reporting needs into functional and technical specs
Explain data issues and designs to business and SAP functional teams
Build SAP Analytics Cloud stories on top of BW models
Use ABAP CDS views and AMDP for extraction and HANA-optimised logic
Work with SAP Datasphere as BW workloads move to the cloud
Tune slow queries and data loads
Handle L2 and L3 support tickets for BW loads and reports
Apply dimensional modelling ideas such as star schemas and layered architectures
